caption:
3 turnover lines that change your tax (2026–27). Turnover means sales, not profit.

$75,000: GST switches on. Once your GST turnover reaches $75,000 you have 21 days to register. From then you add 10% to your prices, claim GST credits on business costs and lodge a BAS.

Under $5 million: the small business income tax offset. Sole traders and partners get 16% of the tax on their business income taken off, capped at $1,000. It's worked out automatically in your return.

Under $10 million: the small business write-offs. The $20,000 instant asset write-off and the 12-month prepayment rule both sit behind this line.

One more for companies: under $50 million (and mostly active income), the company tax rate is 25%.

Most new businesses only ever meet the first one, and usually by surprise.

How close are you to $75K?

Narrated by an AI voice.

#smallbusinessaustralia #gst #soletrader #keepmore #australiantax
figures_checked: GST: register within 21 days of GST turnover reaching $75,000; ride-sourcing and taxi drivers must register regardless of turnover (ATO Registering for GST, checked 11 Nov 2026)

Small business income tax offset: 16% of tax on net small business income, capped at $1,000, aggregated turnover under $5 million, sole traders and partners only, 2026–27 (ATO Small business income tax offset, checked 15 Nov 2026)

Instant asset write-off: assets costing less than $20,000 each, permanent from 1 July 2026, aggregated turnover under $10 million, first used or installed ready for use in the year (ATO Small business newsroom, updated 4 Sept 2026, checked 15 Nov 2026)
Prepaid expenses 12-month rule for small business: service period 12 months or less, ending by the end of the next income year (ATO Deductions for prepaid expenses 2026, checked 12 Nov 2026)
Company tax: base rate entity 25% (turnover under $50 million, passive income 80% or less), 2026–27 (ATO Company tax rate changes, checked 11 Nov 2026)
